BEFORE YOU CALL

STRAIGHT
ANSWERS.

Can you help if my truck has broken down?+

Call Clive on 0474 372 852 with your location and what has happened. He will confirm availability and whether field service is suitable for the job.

Do you service one truck or a whole fleet?+

Both. Sampson Heavy Diesel Services works with individual truck owners, transport operators and fleets. Call to discuss servicing needs and timing.

Which areas do you cover?+

Services are available across Victoria, Australia. Your location, travel requirements and availability are discussed when you call.

Can I arrange transmission or rebuild work?+

Yes. Call with the truck and component details, plus any symptoms you have noticed. Clive can discuss the work and the next step.

How do I arrange planned fleet servicing?+

Call with your truck numbers, makes, service history and preferred dates. Clive will discuss the work, timing and availability for your fleet.
